description: An opaque dark teal crossed-front deel-style coat has broad brown and gold-toned woven borders, geometric or cloud-like embroidered shoulder details, and three-quarter outer sleeves over cream full-length undersleeves. A broad brown decorated sash with ornamental metal fastenings secures the waist. Brown loose trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible. No headgear, armor, or weapon is present.
